DialogueOption.Text: Have you heard that strange signal?

Dialogue.Page: I remember hearing about that back when I was a hatchling. I thought it must have been coming from the quantum shard here on Brittle Hollow.
Only... if that were true, I'd expect it to sound like the others. There must be another one somewhere.
I was planning to look into it once I got here, but then I found the Hanging City, and, well... there's a lot of history down there.
Also a black hole. That part does make exploring a little more complicated.
